method_mapping.original: merge overlapping datetime intervals; sum union duration
method_mapping.adopted: same algorithm with integer monotonic-ns intervals
method_mapping.limits: only intervals with valid start/end; Submitted terminal events included

method_mapping.original: split union time among overlapping categories evenly
method_mapping.limits: even splitting would imply exclusive attribution unsupported by shared-container sampling

method_mapping.original: active_time = last trace timestamp - first trace timestamp
method_mapping.adopted: adapted as the agent observation window (first request/tool start to last end); NOT called active time
method_mapping.limits: uncovered time within the window is NOT thinking/waiting time; it is simply not covered by request or tool intervals

method_mapping.adopted: adapted: frozen rules for the actual command corpus; compound commands classified Mixed when parts differ; navigation (cd) stripped
method_mapping.limits: static text only; does not prove actual subprocess behavior or side effects

method_mapping.original: peak/avg overprovisioning factor; spike duration at 80% of peak (1 sample = 1 s)
method_mapping.adopted: NOT adopted as-is; only peak-to-median memory ratio reported descriptively
method_mapping.limits: no threshold claimed as validated; actual timestamps used, not sample-count-as-seconds

method_mapping.adopted: PROHIBITED by task; uncovered time is reported as uncovered only

uncovered window time is not thinking/waiting time

model usage is not a bill; cost unknown
